<br>

Hi there! I am a current MS in Biostatistics student with a Public Health Data Science track at the Mailman School of Public Health at Columbia University. Previously, I graduated with my BA in Integrative Biology from the University of California, Berkeley. 

I am interested in exposomics/ environmental exposures research, with previous experience serving as a clinical research coordinator for 4 clinical cohort studies examining the interplay of host genetics, microbiome changes, and the exposome as it relates to the pathogenesis and disease outcomes of IBD. I have studied and worked in biological research across disciplines and scales.
